title: Read a maintenance need and brief a technician

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A maintenance record distinguishes due work, completed service, unknown history and user-level observation. A manual excerpt for one model does not apply automatically to another.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Entire fictional device manual excerpt: Model R wheeled storage cart; inspect handle and wheel attachment visually before use, without dismantling; stop use if a wheel is visibly loose; authorized technician checks attachment yearly. This is a constructed training card, not instructions for an actual product. Service record: technician check April 10 last year; today May 1 this year; no later entry. Observation: left wheel appears angled, looseness not confirmed. No running machinery is involved.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Prepare a factual technician brief with model, record date, observation and unknowns. Distinguish the permitted visual check from an unapproved repair.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A bicycle’s manual cannot be matched to its exact model, and the owner guesses tire pressure from another bicycle. What should the brief preserve?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: The annual recorded check is more than a year old; later service is unknown, not certainly absent. Report the angled wheel without diagnosing the fastener. Follow the actual product’s stop/use guidance and seek appropriate inspection before assuming suitability. Partial: report date but omit model. Incorrect: invent torque or claim a photograph certifies safety. No real service was performed.
criteria: Model and record provenance are explicit
Unknown specifications do not become repair instructions

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: Keep the specification unknown and obtain the actual manufacturer/model guidance or competent service help. A nearby model’s value is not established for this equipment.
